response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior software engineer with broad web, mobile, and systems experience, but he lacks the core requirements for this role: no Japanese language proficiency, no demonstrated Linux kernel investigation/modification experience, no listed C proficiency for UNIX systems (his systems work is mostly in DLang, not C), and no exposure to the specific security/networking domains (MACsec, 802.1X, embedded LAN-switch firmware, NETCONF/SNMP). His background is heavily web/product-focused rather than embedded/security firmware.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, senior-level software engineering experience across multiple domains
Demonstrated systems-level programming experience (C/C++ at National Instruments, low-latency DLang work with async I/O and fibers)
Strong track record of ownership, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration in fast-paced environments
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency listed, which is a hard native-level requirement for this role
No evidence of Linux kernel investigation, analysis, or source-code modification experience
No background in required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, tamper detection) or embedded LAN-switch networking domain

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded firmware experience
No relevant security/networking domain expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips)
